title: Preserve living report drill-in state across background refresh
description:
As an operator, I want report drill-in state and reading position to remain stable across background reconciliation, so that I can inspect long optimization reports without the page jumping.

Observed behavior: an unchanged background refresh remounts the optimization presentation, collapses expanded scorecards, and changes layout height.

Feature: Stable living-report interaction during refresh

Scenario: Unchanged reconciliation is a no-op
Given an operator is viewing a report whose durable Report and ReportBlocks have not changed
And the operator has expanded a scorecard and scrolled within the report
When the living-report reconciliation timer completes
Then the report presentation is not remounted
And the expanded scorecard remains expanded
And the reading position remains stable

Scenario: Genuine live progress preserves drill-in state
Given an operator has expanded a scorecard in a living report
When a new progress-only ReportBlock revision arrives
Then the progress indicators update
And the expanded scorecard remains expanded
And the reading position remains stable

Scenario: A new immutable presentation is applied without an arbitrary jump
Given an operator is reading a living report
When a materially new presentation artifact becomes current
Then the new presentation is rendered
And the report preserves a stable reading anchor when possible

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; changes to optimization policy; client-specific report content.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Reproduced in the local dashboard against an existing report. Expanding a scorecard changed aria-expanded to true, then the next background refresh reset it to false without a durable report revision change. Root cause investigation identified unconditional 15-second reconciliation plus unstable Markdown component identities that remount the optimization block. Next: add red regression coverage for no-op refreshes and progress-only rerenders before the smallest fix.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Red/green evidence: added an outside-in ReportTask regression that expands a scorecard, applies a genuine progress-only ReportBlock update, and requires the expansion and loaded score detail to survive. The test failed with aria-expanded=false before the fix and now passes. Added deterministic snapshot coverage so unchanged GraphQL reconciliation is a no-op while progress and TaskStage changes remain visible. Focused validation: 39 tests pass; dashboard web and backend typechecks pass; diff check passes. Browser proof on the local production-backed report: after expansion, two consecutive 15-second reconciliation intervals retained aria-expanded=true and the exact scrollTop value 11553.6357421875; asynchronously loaded detail increased scrollHeight once without moving the reading position. No schema or resource changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented stable living-report rendering and unchanged-snapshot suppression. Focused dashboard validation passed: 33 tests across report rendering, snapshot identity, and optimization status. Production-backed browser verification held an expanded drill-down and the report scroller at exactly 11000 through two refresh intervals. Keep open until the changes land.
